running_thesis: Nasdaq-100 closed 18 Nov at 27116.26 (+0.42%), S&P 500 7323.63 (-0.23%), after a -2.67% day on 16 Nov. Nvidia beat and guided $130B, but shares closed nearly 3% lower, with probes and succession questions open. Cboe calls the 9 Dec hike a near certainty; the October minutes were hawkish and Waller floated 50 bps (Polymarket 50+ bps 6.4%). VIX 24.56, VXN 33.12, COR1M 23.24 and rising, HY OAS 3.43. Anthropic prices at $83 (reported) and debuts Thursday. Oil data stale to 17 Nov.
open_questions: Does the Anthropic debut support or drain AI risk appetite?
Does Nvidia stabilise despite succession and probe overhangs?
Does rising COR1M and wider HY OAS signal contagion beyond tech?
Does 50+ bps hike pricing grow ahead of 9 Dec?
